items.title: Russia warns French military personnel in Ukraine could be targeted
items.summary: Russia's embassy in France warned that French military personnel deployed to Ukraine could be treated as military targets, describing their presence as an escalation. France has acknowledged a limited training and equipment-support presence while denying participation in combat; the competing positions raise concerns about a broader confrontation.

items.title: US defence official questions effectiveness of Ukrainian long-range strikes
items.summary: US Under Secretary of Defense for Policy Elbridge Colby reportedly told Ukraine's supporters in Brussels that deep strikes inside Russia have not significantly slowed Russian advances or brought the war closer to an end. He also suggested such attacks may strengthen Russian public resolve; the assessment is attributed to his reported remarks and has not been independently corroborated.

items.title: Russia alleges strikes on military cargo ship and railway locomotive in Ukraine
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry says its drones struck a cargo ship allegedly transporting military supplies toward Odesa and a locomotive near Kryvyi Rih reportedly used for military logistics. The identity of the ship, the cargo, the damage and any casualties have not been independently confirmed.
